# PS3101 — invariant-conversion-in-loop

<!-- Generated by cmd/gendocs; do not edit. Run make docs. -->

**a loop-invariant string↔[]byte conversion inside a loop**

- Category: `indirect`
- Fix level: **L1**
- Auto-fix: no (advisory)

[]byte(s) and string(b) copy their operand. When the operand
does not change across iterations, the same bytes are copied every pass —
hoist the conversion above the loop.

Only conversions of plain identifiers that the loop body does not reassign
are reported, so every finding is a safe hoist.

## Example

Before:

```go
for _, line := range lines {
	if bytes.Contains(line, []byte(sep)) { ... }
}
```

After:

```go
bsep := []byte(sep)
for _, line := range lines {
	if bytes.Contains(line, bsep) { ... }
}
```

## Suppressing

```go
//perfscan:ignore PS3101 <reason>
```
